typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Reconciliation Name} as string,
		{# of Collateral} as string,
		{Total Break Amount ($ Market Value)} as string,
		{Reporting Date} as string,
		Comments as string,
		{Title (Title)} as string,
		{# of Days OOB} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		Reconciliation_Name as string,
		__of_Collateral as double,
		Total_Break_Amount_____Market_Value_ as double,
		Reporting_Date as string,
		Comments as string,
		Title__Title_ as string,
		__of_Days_OOB as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Reconciliation_Name = {Reconciliation Name},
		__of_Collateral = {# of Collateral},
		Total_Break_Amount_____Market_Value_ = {Total Break Amount ($ Market Value)},
		Reporting_Date = {Reporting Date},
		Comments,
		Title__Title_ = {Title (Title)},
		__of_Days_OOB = {# of Days OOB}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
